source:
@@U00417@@
Happy the man whom Death crowns
with the bloodstained wreath in the blaze of victory!
Or he whom Death finds in the arms of a girl
after the night’s wild revelry!
Oh, how I wish I'd dropped lifeless in purest rapture
overcome by the power of that great spirit!

@@U00419@@
And yet, if ’m not mistaken,
a certain someone failed to drink down a drink,
a brown elixir he'd prepared?

@@U00421@@
Spying, it appears, is second nature to you.

@@U00423@@
I’m not omniscient, but I know a thing or two.

@@U00425@@
I admit it, yes,
I was dragged from my soul’s tumult by music so sweet
it deluded that remnant of childhood in me
with echoes of a happier time.
But I curse it now,
curse it,
all that binds the soul with lures and trickery,
and with lies and flattery confines it to this fleshly cavern,
the miserable valley of despair!
I curse first the mind and its prideful self-exaltation!
I curse the dazzling stab of appearance
that assaults our senses!
I curse the dreams we dream, dreams that lie,
dreams of fame and an enduring name!
I curse property we use to flatter ourselves,
wife and child, man and plow!
I curse Mammon when with the promise of riches
he incites us to rash deeds,
or fluffs our pillows for a sensuous diversion!
translation:
@@U00417@@
被死亡加冕的人是幸福的
在胜利的火焰中带着血迹斑斑的花环！
或者死亡在女孩怀里发现的他
经过一夜的狂欢之后！
哦，我多么希望我能在最纯粹的狂喜中死去
被那伟大精神的力量所征服！

@@U00419@@
然而，如果没记错的话，
某人没喝完酒，
他配制的棕色灵丹妙药？

@@U00421@@
看来，从事间谍活动是你的第二天性。

@@U00423@@
我不是无所不知，但我知道一两件事。

@@U00425@@
我承认，是的，
如此甜美的音乐将我从灵魂的喧嚣中拉了出来
它迷惑了我内心残留的童年
伴随着幸福时光的回声。
但我现在诅咒它，
诅咒它，
一切用诱惑和诡计束缚灵魂的东西，
并用谎言和奉承将其限制在这个肉体的洞穴里，
悲惨的绝望之谷！
我首先诅咒心灵及其骄傲的自我抬高！
我咒骂那耀眼的外表
这侵犯了我们的感官！
我诅咒我们的梦想，谎言的梦想，
梦想成名和永恒的名字！
我诅咒我们用来奉承自己的财产，
妻子和孩子，男人和犁！
当我许诺财富时我会诅咒玛门
他煽动我们做出鲁莽的事，
或者让我们的枕头变得蓬松以进行感官上的消遣！
